title: The Serpent's Jaws
wikitext:
{{Infobox Quest |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= [[File:BotW The Serpent's Jaws.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |type= Shrine |game= BotW |giver= [[Kass]] |location= Pagos Woods |prereq= |req= |reward= [[Shae Katha Shrine]] |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|The Serpent's Jaws||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Shrine Quest]] in {{BotW}}. ==Overview== [[File:BotW Kass Pagos Woods.png|thumb|right|320px|alt= Screenshot of Kass standing on Zonai Ruins.|Kass in Pagos Woods]] In the [[Pagos Woods]], [[Link]] can encounter [[Kass]] singing about a forest dragon along the edge of the [[Faron Highroad]]. Kass is surprised to meet someone else so deep in the Woods. He knows an "[[Ancient Song]]" pertaining to this location, which he asks Link if he would like to hear. If Link agrees, Kass excitedly shares the song with him. The lyrics describe an [[Ancient Shrine]] found between the jaws of a forest [[Dragon]]. However, Kass has never seen a Dragon in this forest, but he suspects it is referring to [[Damel Forest]]. He knows for certain that there is a secret to be found, after which he wishes Link well on his journey. Once he is done speaking, the [[Shrine Quest]] begins. If Link has already completed the quest before speaking to Kass, he will be impressed and slightly unnerved. Speaking to him again will have Kass wonder aloud if Link can see into the future. After passing the ruins at [[Dracozu Lake]] in Damel Forest, Link will find the [[Spring of Courage]] inside the ruins of a Dragon head. When he prays to the [[Spring of Courage Statue]], a large [[Goddess Statue]] that can be found at the Spring, he will hear the voice of [[Hylia]] congratulating him for finding the Spring. She instructs him to offer [[Farosh's Scale]] and promises to guide him. Farosh's Scale can be obtained by shooting [[Farosh]]'s body with an [[Arrow]]. It flies out of [[Riola Spring]] and through [[Lake Floria]] nearby. In addition, it is found over the [[Vatorsa Snowfield]] in the [[Gerudo Highlands]] and in [[Lake Hylia]]. Once Link has obtained one of Farosh's Scale, he can return to the Spring of Courage. [[File:BotW Shae Katha Shrine.png|thumb|right|320px|alt= Screenshot of the Shrine within the ruins.|Shae Katha Shrine]] At the Spring of Courage, Link must drop Farosh's Scale into the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Doing so causes the door behind the Goddess Statue to open, revealing the path to [[Shae Katha Shrine]]. With the way clear, Hylia tells him to go forward. After this, the Shrine Quest is completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | The ancient song that Kass sang at Pagos Woods is hinting at something...

"Where the forest {{Color BotW|Blue|dragon}} splays its jaws,
A {{Color BotW|Red|shrine}} sleeps with noble cause."

Your task is to decipher its riddle. |- | 2 | Kass recited the lyrics to an ancient song when you met him in Pagos Woods. You figured out the hidden meaning of the song and discovered the Spring of Courage as a result. It was at that moment that the voice of the Goddess spoke to you.

"Offer {{Color BotW|Red|Farosh's scale}} received from the golden spirit to the Spring of Courage."

What's a {{Color BotW|Red|Farosh's scale}}? |- | Complete | "Offer {{Color BotW|Red|Farosh's scale}} received from the golden spirit to the Spring of Courage."

Just as the Goddess instructed, you threw {{Color BotW|Red|Farosh's scale}} into the Spring of Courage. A shrine appeared as a result! }} ==Trivia== * Part of this Shrine Quest was shown before the release of {{BotW|-}} in a promotional video. * This Shrine Quest is hinted at in ''[[Kass's Journal]]'', a [[Book]] found in a hut on [[Washa's Bluff]].
